split.interpretation: Two subsets of one measured cloud, not independent surveys or map-accuracy ground truth

note: Full supplied point clouds, no thinning, one production analysis worker and pool. Five warm-up pairs precede alternating sequential waiting/pipelined cold prepared CPU computations. Every mode reloads identical reference bytes under a fresh identity, retiring the preceding CPU preparation outside timing; the compared cloud stays unchanged. Both controls build the same exact partitions, reference trees and Morton order and use scalar f64 searches, progressive joins, adaptive summaries, f32 inlier arithmetic and the existing Map quality voxel kernel. Only cold search dispatch differs: waiting requires the lane preparation ack; pipelined queues search on the same live worker generation immediately behind preparation, allowing it to search without another main-worker turn. Both messages must succeed and are drained on failure. Each cold call is followed by an independently recomputed warm call with the same mode/preparation; those times and parity are separate and warm order follows cold order. Wall times include planning, transfers, tree construction, search, joins, metrics and result RPCs; pool initialization/prewarming, loading, old-state release and validation are excluded. Worker millis are recorded separately. This measures cold source-pair preparation in an already warmed worker pool, not browser/process startup. Neither result distances nor voxel scores are cached. Every cold and warm pair must preserve all distance bits and f64 summary fields; inlier metrics/voxel counts are exact and existing HashMap voxel reductions allow 1e-12 relative/absolute roundoff. Retained input bytes exclude derived tree/order storage, allocator overhead, source clouds and outputs and are equal between controls. Other applications, CPU clocks, power and GC are uncontrolled. Measured-source even/odd subsets are not independent survey ground truth.
